name: home-freeroam-2

status.title: Free roam
lines: Free roam: Center, Left, until each is at 10 % or 0.1 h. Ctrl+C (or ./run-fleet-pi.sh freeroam-stop) stops every robot.

Board assumed: x 0 to 122 cm, y 0 to 122 cm (122 x 122 cm, from the simulator's board). Edge rule: derived (e08): a robot's middle stays half its diagonal (6.7 cm) + its position uncertainty now + the camera's edge error (5 cm) from every edge along the whole path, plus its stopping distance where it stops: about 12.7 cm along a path and 15.1 cm where a move ends when the camera and the robot agree, more when they do not. Walls or objects inside it are found during the run: a front stop felt twice, or an edge-guard or tilt stop, becomes a keep-out; one felt once fades after 15 s (events: keep-out; keepouts.csv).
[   60.0] Left move 57% 20 moves; Center move 6% 20 moves
[  120.0] Left move 27% 38 moves; Center move 6% 40 moves
The run ends: the time cap (0.1 h).

where: This looks like home (the 4 x 4 ft board) (the table measures 122 x 122 cm, its size and its cameras USB 2.0 Camera and EMEET SmartCam C950 plugged in).
